_README: IMAGE n in van-sale-user-manual.md -> the file below. Drop the capture into
this folder under exactly that name and rebuild; nothing in the Markdown changes.
A slot with no file on disk still renders its bordered plate and caption, so the
manual is always complete and simply gets better as captures arrive.
Shoot on the tablet in portrait unless 'landscape' is stated. Do not include any
customer's real name or a real payment card in a capture.

1.capture: Sign-in screen: 'Welcome back', 'Login to continue to your store', the ACCOUNT card with Username or Email and Password, and the Auto Fill Credentials switch.

2.capture: Home, scrolled to the top: company logo, banner carousel, the date/time pill, the 'Quick Access / Manage your store' bar, and at least the Sales & POS and Inventory sections.

3.capture: HAVE IT. Profile: Connected badge, User ID / Database / Role / Login, the HELP card with User Manual and Show to users, Logout, and the Home/Profile/Logout tab bar. Footer reads v1.3.0 - re-take on a v1.4.0 build when convenient.

4.capture: POS Register: an AVAILABLE register card showing 'Tap below to open this register and start a new session.' and its Open Register button. Ideally an Active Sessions card visible above it too.

5.capture: The Opening Control popup: Opening cash with 'Cash currently in the drawer.', the Opening note box, Discard and Open Register.

6.capture: The Register screen with three or four lines in the basket, one line selected so the Discount and Note chips are showing, and the Total block with a '- Discount' line.

7.capture: The POS product picker: Search Products, the category chips including 'All (n)', the grid with orange + buttons, and the floating Go to Register button.

8.capture: The Select Discount popup: DISCOUNT TYPE (Total/Items), DISCOUNT FORMAT (Percentage/Amount), the preset grid and the Apply button.

9.capture: The customer picker opened from the Register screen, showing rows with the ID Proof F / ID Proof B badges and the eye icon.

10.capture: KEY SHOT. The Payment screen for a customer who owes money: TOTAL, the Subtotal/Discount/Tax breakdown, and the amber Previous Due card underneath. Use a test customer with an unpaid invoice.

11.capture: The Split Payment popup: Total to collect, Method 1 and Method 2 with their Cash/Card chips, amounts entered, and the 'Entered x / y' pill.

12.capture: The signature popup: 'Capture the customer and cashier signatures', both CUSTOMER SIGNATURE and CASHIER SIGNATURE pads with a signature on at least one, and DONE.

13.capture: The receipt screen after validating: green tick, 'Order Placed', the order number, DATE/TIME/LOCATION strips and the RECEIPT PREVIEW block. Scroll so the action chips are visible if possible.

14.capture: The 'Choose receipt size' popup with a purple Default badge on one row and the 'Custom width (mm)' row expanded to show Width (mm) and Use this size.

15.capture: The Orders list showing the All/Paid/Draft/Cancelled chips and at least one row carrying the red REFUND badge alongside normal Paid rows.

16.capture: An open paid order: the hero card, the DATE/CUSTOMER/SALESPERSON/REGISTER grid, ITEMS, and the action chips including the red Return Products chip.

17.capture: The 'Return Products?' confirmation popup with its full message and the CANCEL / RETURN buttons.

18.capture: The Customers list with Search Customers and several rows showing the ID Proof F / ID Proof B badges, at least one ticked.

19.capture: The New Contact form: the Person/Company switch, 'Name *', Email, Phone with the +968 dial-code button and the digits hint.

20.capture: The Products list: Search Products, the category chips with counts, the 'Showing n of n' line, the grid, and the Show Archived button.

21.capture: HAVE IT. Edit Product with Track Inventory ticked, Dozen Display unticked, and Save Changes dimmed because nothing has been altered yet.

22.capture: The Select Category picker with several categories ticked, the colour dots and pencils visible, and Add Category at the bottom.

23.capture: The New Unit of Measure popup: Unit Name *, Reference Unit, the interpolated 'Contains (how many Units)' label, and the '1 Pack of 20 = 20 Units' helper line filled in.

24.capture: New/Edit Product with Dozen Display ticked: Pieces per Dozen, On Hand (Dozens), and the '= 9 Dozen 7 Pcs' helper line beneath them.

25.capture: The 'Can't Delete Product' popup with Odoo's reason text and the ARCHIVE INSTEAD and CLOSE buttons. Needs a product that has been sold.

26.capture: The Stock list: Search Stock, the All / In Stock / Low Stock / Out of Stock pills, the PDF and Excel buttons, and rows with Out / Low / In Stock badges.

27.capture: The New Purchase form scrolled to show Purchase Header, Payment & Warehouse, and the Product Lines card with at least one line added.

28.capture: KEY SHOT. Quick Return form with a vendor bill picked, showing a line card with the Purchased / Already Returned / Max Returnable / Return Qty cells and the orange 'Return all' pill.

29.capture: The Invoices list: Search by invoice # or customer, the All/Posted/Draft/Cancelled tabs, the Filters and Group By pills, and rows with their state chips.

30.capture: Partner Ledger with the Filters box open showing Posting Status / Reconciliation / Journal / Accounts, plus removable chips above the table and the pinned Total row.

31.capture: The Sales Report screen with a period selected and results on show.

32.capture: Device Setup with all three steps filled: Server URL, a Database chosen from the list, and the Admin Credentials boxes, with Configure Device at the bottom. BLUR the server address before use.

33.capture: The Scan QR Code screen with the camera live and the status line 'Point camera at the QR code on the admin screen'.

34.capture: The Users list showing the ADMINISTRATORS and USERS section headers with counts, an ADMIN badge on a row, and the New User button.

35.capture: KEY SHOT. Apps Privileges with a non-admin user selected, a group such as Home Tiles expanded, some rows showing Hidden and others Visible, and the 'Visibility changes apply on the user's next login.' banner.

36.capture: HAVE IT. The Invoice Settings hub: the three cards General Settings / Receipt Paper Sizes / Invoice Layouts with their subtitles.

37.capture: General Settings showing the Invoice Template radio group with all four options (Standard / Dynamic / Cash Memo / Custom Layout (editable)) and the Preview button.

38.capture: General Settings on the Cash Memo template: the Cash Memo Header card with the name fields and the Show Company Name / Show C.R. Number / Show GSM / Show Sultanate of Oman / Show VAT Number switches.

39.capture: Receipt Paper Sizes: the explanatory paragraph, several sizes with their reorder chevrons, and the locked Custom row showing its padlock. Ideally the New Paper Size popup open beside it.

40.capture: The Invoice Layouts list showing one layout per paper size, each tagged Grid or Flow.

41.capture: LANDSCAPE. The Visual Editor with all three panels visible - Design, Options and Live Preview - a block selected so Options is populated, and the toolbar showing Save/Undo/Redo/Grid/Add/Reset.

42.capture: The App Banners list with a couple of banners showing their Active / Inactive status and the New Banner button.

43.capture: The User Manual screen with a document list, ideally with the View / Download popup open over it.
